title: rudbeckia subtomentosa f. craigii
intro: Rudbeckia subtomentosa f. craigii, commonly known as Prairie Coneflower, is a flowering plant species native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia subtomentosa f. craigii include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive compounds in this plant have been reported to include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
